# opnsense_routing_gateway_group (Data Source)

Gateway groups combine gateways into tiers for failover and load balancing. Requires OPNsense 26.7 or later.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the gateway group.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `members` (Map of Number) Gateways in the group, keyed by gateway name, with their tier as value.
- `name` (String) Group name.
- `pool_options` (String) Load-balancing behaviour between gateways of the same tier.
- `trigger` (String) When a member is considered down.
